If you're looking for a free alternative to OpusClip for transforming longer videos into engaging short-form content, several tools offer similar AI-powered features for repurposing video, automatic captioning, and optimising for platforms like TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels.

Here are some of the best free alternatives:

*   **Vizard.ai** Vizard Agent is an AI-powered video editing tool designed to convert long video footage into short-form content. It uses advanced AI auto-clipping to identify and highlight engaging moments, making them ready for platforms like YouTube Shorts and TikTok. Vizard.ai offers a free AI video editing tier that allows users to upload, transcribe, and generate fully edited short videos. It can transcribe, extract highlights, trim, and add captions automatically. Vizard is considered a strong alternative, with its AI picking engaging moments based on context, offering more relevant clips compared to some alternatives. It also offers a generous free tier for testing long uploads, with up to 60 minutes per upload.
*   **Choppity** Choppity is another free AI clip maker that specialises in turning long videos into viral short clips. You can paste a video link or upload a file, and its AI will transcribe the video, find strong short-form moments, and generate vertical clips with animated captions. The free plan allows you to generate and preview clips.
*   **CapCut** CapCut is a widely popular free video editing app available online, on Windows, and mobile devices. It's known for its user-friendly interface and a comprehensive set of features suitable for all skill levels. While CapCut offers many advanced editing features like keyframe animation, smooth slow-motion, chroma key, stabilisation, auto captions, text-to-speech, and background removal, it does not currently have AI clip detection like OpusClip. However, its robust set of manual and intelligent features makes it an excellent choice for creating professional-quality short videos.
*   **Clipchamp** Microsoft's Clipchamp is a free online video editor that provides essential editing tools like trimming, rotating, resizing, cropping, and green screen effects. It also includes features like text-to-speech and various text title templates, making it suitable for beginners. Clipchamp is continuously being improved with time-saving updates for an enhanced online video editing experience.
*   **Canva** Canva offers a free AI Shorts Maker that can create engaging, high-quality short-form videos quickly. You can upload your raw clips and use "Magic Design for Video" to generate videos, or even provide an idea for "Magic Media" to generate visuals, audio, and special effects from scratch. This makes it useful for repurposing longer content into bite-sized clips.
*   **Kapwing** Kapwing offers an AI video editor that combines AI video generation with a full AI editing suite in a browser. It can automatically transform prompts and images into edited video projects. You can upload footage and ask AI to add subtitles, trim and arrange clips, apply filters, or enhance video quality. Its "Clip Maker" feature can generate short clips from one video.

When choosing an alternative, consider how much you rely on AI for automatic clip selection and repurposing, as some tools like Vizard.ai and Choppity focus heavily on this, while others like CapCut and Clipchamp offer more comprehensive manual editing capabilities with some AI-assisted features.
